title: RAG pipeline simulation: poisoned retrieval in shared context vs debate vs private

notes: Simulates a RAG pipeline where one retrieved document is wrong.
Tests whether the poisoned retrieval spreads through shared context.
Compares shared record vs debate vs private — same as main experiment but RAG framing.
4 liars represent agents that retrieved the poisoned document and committed to it.
Drug interaction task — practical, not scientific trivia.
